mechanism_narrative: A quarterly increase in GDPC1 exceeding 2% YoY signals strengthening aggregate demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 50% of quarters with GDPC1 YoY growth > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained FEDFUNDS rate below 0.5% indicates accommodative monetary policy, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns during periods of FEDFUNDS < 0.5% are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: When UNRATE falls below 5% and PAYEMS growth exceeds 200,000 jobs per month, a tightening labor market signals positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC for this mechanism remains below 0.01 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in INDPRO exceeding 1.5% MoM signals supply chain resilience, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 40% of months with INDPRO MoM growth > 1.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in RSAFS by more than 5% MoM signals reduced consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC for this mechanism remains below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS exceeds 2% and CPIAUCSL growth is above 2% YoY, a hawkish monetary stance signals negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 55% of instances with FEDFUNDS > 2% and CPIAUCSL YoY growth > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: An always-on signal: positive S&P 500 forward returns are expected over the next 5 trading days due to the overall labor market's influence on consumer confidence.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of low UNRATE (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When HOUST exceeds 1,200,000 units and GDPC1 growth is above 3% YoY, a booming housing market and strong GDP growth signal positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC for this mechanism remains below 0.04 over any 1.5-year rolling window.
